description: This file contains helper functions related to sensor endpoints in a device management context. It provides functionality for extracting resource information from data structures, and checking the faulted and bypassed states of endpoints via resource attributes or events.

methods.name: const char * extractResource(icHashMap * map,const char * ownerUri,const char * resourceName)
methods.description: Extracts a specific resource value from a hash map based on a constructed URI from ownerUri and resourceName.

methods.name: bool isEndpointFaulted(DSEndpoint * endpoint)
methods.description: Checks if a given DSEndpoint is in a faulted state by examining its resources.

methods.name: bool isEndpointFaultedViaEvent(DeviceServiceResourceUpdatedEvent * event)
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint is faulted based on a DeviceServiceResourceUpdatedEvent.

methods.name: bool isEndpointBypassed(DSEndpoint * endpoint)
methods.description: Checks if a given DSEndpoint is bypassed by examining its resources.

methods.name: bool isEndpointBypassedViaEvent(DeviceServiceResourceUpdatedEvent * event)
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint is bypassed based on a DeviceServiceResourceUpdatedEvent.

ctags.name: extractResource
ctags.pattern: /^static const char *extractResource(icHashMap *map, const char *ownerUri, const char *resourceNam/
